archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL SCI-FI HUD
summary: Tactical, clean Gundam TCG collection & sale lifecycle tracker with high-contrast tactical HUD visual language, high density table & grid views, AUD currency, and instant filters for color, type, rarity, sale lifecycle, buyers, and deal dates.

rules.labels: JetBrains Mono Variable, text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400

entry_surfaces./: tactical HUD top bar + dynamic stats strip, followed by segmented lifecycle tabs (All / For Sale / Pending / Sold / Archived) with dual card-grid & dense table view

layouts.header: Fixed HUD bar with brand emblem, quick search bar, quick action buttons ('Add Card', 'Add Item', 'Batch Export/Import'), and active filter chips indicator
layouts.stats_strip: High-density 4-tile grid: Total Inventory Units, Portfolio Valuation (AUD $), Items on Sale / Pending, Realized Sales & Profit (AUD $)
layouts.filter_drawer_and_bar: Compact multi-faceted bar: Color Pills (All, Red, White, Blue, Green, Purple), Type Dropdown (Unit, Pilot, Ex Base, Ex Resource, Resource, Command, Base, Unit Token), Rarity Selector (C, C+, C++, UC, UC+, R, R+, LR, LR+, LR++, SP, P, LK), Buyer Search text input, and Deal Date Range picker
layouts.lifecycle_tabs: Tabs with badge counts: 'All Items', 'For Sale', 'Pending Deal', 'Sold', 'Archive (Restorable)'
layouts.inventory_display: Toggle between Visual Mecha Card Grid (with high-visibility color trims and holographic rarity stamps) and Pro Data Table (sortable columns, inline status actions, quick edit, price editing in AUD)

components.quick_add_card_modal: Shadcn Dialog with form fields: Name, Item Category (Card vs General Item/Accessory/Binder/Booster), Color (5 Gundam colors), Card Type (8 types), Rarity (14 tiers), Quantity, Unit Price in AUD ($), Condition, Notes, Image URL / Preset icon, Sale Status (In Collection, For Sale, Pending, Sold).
components.quick_add_item_modal: Shadcn Dialog specifically tailored for non-card Gundam merchandise (Deck Boxes, Sleeves, Playmats, Model Kits, Booster Boxes) with price AUD, quantity, status, notes.
components.deal_closure_modal: Shadcn Dialog triggered when moving item to 'Pending' or 'Sold': inputs for Buyer Name, Buyer Contact/Handle, Deal Date (calendar picker with default to today), Agreed Sale Price AUD, Payment Method, and auto-archive toggle.
components.archive_view: Table & list of sold/archived items with deal summary (Sold to X on DD/MM/YYYY for $X.XX AUD) with one-click 'Restore to Active Inventory' and 'Permanent Delete' options.
components.rarity_badge: Distinct visual badges with foil gradients: Common (C, C+, C++), Uncommon (UC, UC+), Rare (R, R+), Legend Rare (LR, LR+, LR++), Special / Promo (SP, P, LK - Link Rare).
components.color_indicator: Distinct left-border or glow dot matching Red, White, Blue, Green, Purple Gundam factions.

image_urls.description: Epic Gundam statue for background ambient atmosphere
High detail mecha model figure for sample Unit card art
Gundam aerial pose for high rarity card samples

motion.page_transition: Subtle opacity and slight y-axis slide (0.15s ease-out)
motion.card_hover: Transform -translate-y-1 with subtle cyan/amber border glow boost (0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1))
motion.filter_chip_active: Spring scale transition with active tactical highlight
motion.modal_entrance: Scale from 0.96 to 1.0 with backdrop blur

accessibility.color_blindness: All color badges pair solid high-contrast text with clear icon/text labels (e.g. 'RED [EFSF]' or 'BLUE [ZEON]') so color is never the sole differentiator
accessibility.screen_reader_labels: All action buttons (edit, delete, quick-sell, restore) have aria-label and descriptive tooltip text
accessibility.locale_defaults: Currency explicitly formatted as AUD $ (e.g. A$24.50), date formats formatted clearly as DD/MM/YYYY (Australian standard).

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + React 19 / Vite frontend). Use the typed fetch client in frontend/src/lib/api.ts and keep FastAPI models in sync with TS interfaces.

Strict Gundam TCG attributes required: Colors = ['red', 'white', 'blue', 'green', 'purple']; Types = ['unit', 'pilot', 'ex base', 'ex resource', 'resource', 'command', 'base', 'unit token']; Rarities = ['C', 'C+', 'C++', 'UC', 'UC+', 'R', 'R+', 'LR', 'LR+', 'LR++', 'SP', 'P', 'LK'].
Currency MUST be AUD (Australian Dollar) throughout: formats like A$45.00 or $45.00 AUD.

Sale lifecycle flow: Items start as 'For Sale' or 'In Collection'. When marked 'Pending', prompt for Buyer Name, Buyer Contact, Deal Date, and Agreed Price AUD. When marked 'Sold', auto-move to the 'Archive' tab (with clear feedback and instant 'Restore' option).

Filters must be instant and combined: Search by card/item name, Filter by Color, Filter by Type, Filter by Rarity, Filter by Sale Status, Filter by Buyer Name, Filter by Deal Date (from/to or exact date).
Provide both 'Add Card' (full TCG stats: color, type, rarity, AP/HP, notes, qty, price) and 'Add Item' (general Gundam merchandise/supplies: name, category, price AUD, qty, notes) forms.

Include pre-seeded sample data featuring famous Gundam cards (e.g. RX-78-2 Gundam [White/Unit/LR], Amuro Ray [White/Pilot/R+], Char Aznable [Red/Pilot/LR++], MSN-04 Sazabi [Red/Unit/SP], Wing Gundam Zero [Blue/Unit/LK], Strike Freedom [Purple/Unit/LR+], etc.) so the dashboard is immediately vibrant and functional.
Ensure all interactive components and table rows have standard data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow 'easy to read and navigate' core mandate: crisp typography, distinct visual status pills, generous padding inside table cells and modal cards.
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric pricing and card count counters for clean tabular scanability.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML dropdowns; use shadcn dialogs, popovers, select, badges, and tabs.
Ensure sonner toasts confirm every action (Card Added, Deal Closed, Item Restored, Price Updated).
